description: Build a reusable template (base image) so you can launch sandboxes with a specific vCPU/memory/disk shape or preinstalled software. Sandboxes inherit the template's resources; build it with a range (vcpu_max / memory_max_mib) to let sandbox_create pick a fixed vcpu or memory_mib within it. The build runs asynchronously: this returns immediately with status 'building' (or 'pending'). Poll sandbox_template_list (filter by name) until the template's status is 'ready' before passing it to sandbox_create's from_template. A build can take a few minutes.

disk_mib.description: Disk (MiB) for sandboxes built from this template.

from.description: Base image to build from, e.g. a Docker image like 'python:3.11' or 'ubuntu:24.04'.

memory_max_mib.description: Optional ceiling (MiB) sandboxes from this template can grow memory to while running; memory_mib stays the boot size. Must exceed memory_mib, be at most 4 times it, and differ from it by a multiple of 128. Omit for a fixed memory size.

memory_mib.description: Memory (MiB) for sandboxes built from this template.

memory_shrink_after_seconds.description: Optional. How long, in seconds, a sandbox's memory must stay low after growing before it shrinks back toward memory_mib (60 to 1800). Requires memory_max_mib. Sandboxes created from the template inherit it. Omit for the platform default.

name.description: Template name (your team's namespace; cannot start with the reserved 'superserve/').

ready_cmd.description: Command that must exit 0 before the build is considered ready.

run_steps.description: Shell commands run in order at build time, e.g. ['pip install numpy', 'apt-get install -y git']. Use these for env/workdir too (e.g. 'export X=Y && ...').

start_cmd.description: Command to start when a sandbox boots from this template.

vcpu.description: vCPU count for sandboxes built from this template.

vcpu_max.description: Optional ceiling sandboxes from this template can grow their vCPU count to while running; vcpu stays the starting count. Must exceed vcpu, be at most 4 times it and at most 32. Omit for a fixed vCPU count.

name: sandbox_template_create
title: Build a custom template
